decision.explanation: The original sources provide two distinct, non-contradictory affiliations for Eduardo G. Yukihara. Document 1 (D1) explicitly states via HR records and faculty confirmation that he was employed by 'Oklahoma State University–Stillwater' from 2005 to 2010. Document 2 (D2), a narrative text, describes him working at the 'Babraham Institute', noting his lab coat bore the Institute's logo and his work was supported by its resources. Both documents positively assign a different organization to the same person, satisfying the requirement to preserve distinct valid referents and complementary answers rather than collapsing them into a single entity.
